content: Isau popoŋana kini
Iŋgi Isau ziŋan popoŋana kini mbol kizin. (Isau zaana toro Edom.)
Isau iwoolo moori ru kizin Kanaan: Ada mi Olibama. Ada, ni Elon lutuunu moori. Mi Elon, ni uunu ipet pa Et. Mi Olibama, ni tamaana Ana mi tumbuunu Zibeon. Zibeon, ni uunu ipet pa Ep.
Mi Isau iwoolo Basemat tomini. Ni Ismael lutuunu moori, mi Nebaiot lunuri.
Ada ipeebe Elipas. Mi Basemat ipeebe Reuel.
Mi Olibama ipeebe Yeus, Yalam, mi Kora. Zin pikin ki Isau tina, ta tisu Kanaan.

Kaimer to Isau imaŋga, mi ikam kusiini bizin, lutuunu bizin, mi wal boozomen ta ziŋan timbotmbot ruumu kini na, ramaki zin mbili mi koroŋ kini boozomen ta ikam su Kanaan na, mi izem tiziini Yakop ma ila pa lele pakaana toro.
Paso, Yakop ziru Isau, mbili kizin boozo kat. Tana toono irao be ziru timbot mbata na som.
Tana Isau ta zaana toro Edom na, ila ma imbot pa lele abalabalŋana ki Seir.
Iŋgi mbol ki Isau ta popoŋana kini tipet ma tiwe wal ki Edom, mi timbotmbot pa lele abalabalŋana ki Seir na.
Isau lutuunu bizin tipet ta kembei: Kusiini Ada ipeebe Elipas, mi kusiini Basemat ipeebe Reuel.
Isau lutuunu Elipas lutuunu bizin ta zan tis: Teman, Omar, Sepo, Gatam, mi Kenas.
Elipas, ni iwoolo moori toro tomini, zaana Timna. Mi Timna, ni ipeebe Amalek. Ina Ada tumbuunu bizin.
Mi Reuel lutuunu bizin ta zan tis: Naat, Sera, Samma, mi Mizza. Ina zin tina ta Basemat tumbuunu bizin.
Mi Olibama na, ipeebe pikin tel ta zan tis: Yeus, Yalam, mi Kora.

Isau popoŋana kini tana tila timbot leŋaleŋa. Mi timender pa urum kizin kizin. Isau lutuunu muŋgamuŋga Elipas, ni lutuunu bizin ta zan tis: Teman, Oman, Sepo, Kenas, Kora, Gatam, mi Amalek. Zin popoŋana ki Elipas tina timbot lele pakaana ki Edom, mi timender pa urum kizin kizin. Ina Ada tumbuunu bizin.
To ki Reuel ta Naat, Zera, Samma, mi Mizza. Zin popoŋana ki Reuel tina, zin tomini timbot lele pakaana ki Edom, mi timender pa urum kizin kizin. Ina Basemat tumbuunu bizin.
Mi Olibama na, ni ipeebe Yeus, Yalam, mi Kora. Mi zin tomini timender pa urum kizin kizin.
Wal ta boozomen tana, ta Isau popoŋana kini men. Mi zin ta boozomen timender pa urum kizin kizin.
Seir popoŋana kini

Tomooto ta, zaana Seir, ni imbot lele ki Edom tomini. Ni uunu ipet pa Or. Iŋgi Seir lutuunu bizin ta zan tis: Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dison, Ezer, mi Disan. Seir lutuunu bizin tina, ta tikamam peeze pizin Or ta timbot su lele pakaana ki Edom na.
Lotan kini ta Ori mi Omam. Mi Lotan lunuri zaana Timna.
Mi Sobal lutuunu bizin na, Alban, Manaat, Ebal, Sepo, mi Onam.
To Zibeon kini ta Aya mi Ana. Ana tina, ta imborro zin doŋki ki tamaana isu lele bilimŋana mi indeeŋe yok bayouŋana na.
Ana ipeebe pikin ru. Tomooto, ta zaana Dison, mi moori ta zaana Olibama.
Dison na, lutuunu bizin tis: Emdan, Esban, Itran, mi Keran.
Mi Ezer kini na, Bilan, Zaaban, mi Akan.
To Disan lutuunu bizin ta Us mi Aran.
Tana zin Or kan merere kizin tis: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Ezer, mi Disan. Zin tina ta tiwe merere pizin wal ki Or. Mi zin tataŋa timender pa urum kizin kizin isu Seir.
Zin king kizin Edom
Muŋgu, indeeŋe king sa imboro zin Israel zen na, zin king ti ta timboro lele pakaana ki Edom.
Bela ta Beor lutuunu i, ni king mataana kana ta imboro lele pakaana ki Edom. Ni kar kini Dinaaba.
Bela imeete, to Zera lutuunu Yobap, ikam muriini. Yobap, ni kar kini Bosra.
Yobap imeete, to Usam ikam muriini. Usam imar pa toono kizin Teman.
Usam imeete, to Bedat lutuunu Adad ikam muriini. Adad, ni kar kini ta Abit. Ni ziŋan zin wal ki Midian tiporou su lele ki Moap ma ilip pizin.
Adad imeete, to Samla ikam muriini. Samla, ni kar kini Masreka.
Imbotmbot ma imeete, to Saul ikam muriini. Saul, ni kar kini Reobot. Kar tana igarau pa yok biibi Euprates.
Saul imeete, to Akbor lutuunu Bal-Anan ikam muriini.
Bal-Anan imeete, to Adad ikam muriini. Adad, ni kar kini Pau, mi kusiini zaana Meetabel. Meetabel naana Matret, mi tumbuunu moori Me-Zaab.

Tana iŋgi zin merere ta tipet pa Isau: Timna, Alba, Yetet, Olibima, Ela, Pinon, Kenas, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, mi Iram. Wal tina ta zin merere ki Edom, mi zin tataŋa timboro toono kizin kizin. Isau popoŋana kini tana, ta tipet ma tiwe wal ki Edom.
